alt: Medieval Arab manuscript painting from al-Wasiti's Maqamat of al-Hariri showing a procession of camels, drummers, trumpeters and banners setting off with a pilgrim litter.
note: Contemporary-era (13th c.) Islamic manuscript art of a pilgrim caravan; fits the brief generally (not Ibn Battuta himself, so alt describes it neutrally). Public domain. cand-1 is a tents scene with Arabic captions and a less clear hajj link; Canterbury Pilgrims is the wrong culture.
